acceptance_criteria.description: The run retains the Terminal-Bench commit, Harbor executable digest, pinned Docker image identities, resolved manifest digest, and network observation.
The unchanged regex-log verifier produces digest-bound ctrf.json and test-stdout.txt within the declared cold-start budget.
The no-provider reward zero with valid completion evidence is persisted as verified_fail, never verifier_error, timeout, or an Agent score.
The explicit none-model execution retains observed zero tokens and cost and the schedule budget reconciles exactly.
The observation report, record index, referenced bytes, and standalone verifier all pass from retained evidence.

objective: Run the unchanged regex-log verifier with the no-provider subject in a fresh root under a preregistered 900-second cold-start budget, then retain and independently verify the official CTRF, stdout, runtime identity, zero usage, report, and record index.
title: Verify cold Terminal-Bench verifier completion under an explicit infrastructure budget
